They love treats. If you can find 5 pet treats around the park, I bet they'll come to you.

Run over a sweet to pick it up, then run into the bin that matches it!
Ring Toss. Drop the ring when it's over the glowing bottle. Ring 3 of 5 to win!
Duck Pond. Every duck hides a picture. Flip two at a time and find all the matching pairs.
The floor is lava! Jump the whole course to the prize. Fall in and you start again. It never hurts.
Aim with the plus and press LT to put it down, RT to take it away. LB and RB pick what.
Aim with the plus and press LT to place, RT to break. LB and RB pick the piece. Double-tap A to fly!
The floor is chocolate! Jump the whole course to the prize. Light a candy flag and falling in only sends you back to the flag.
